item.title: CryptoNotch 1.6.0
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.6.0

    ### What's New in v1.6.0
  • **Native Desktop Price Alerts:** Set threshold price alerts (▲ Above / ▼ Below) directly from your MacBook notch.
  • **Top Notch Bell Action:** Frosted glass bell action button with active state badge indicator.
  • **Quick Percentage Chips:** 1-tap calculation pills (-5%, -2%, +2%, +5%) for instant target price setting.
  • **Live Background Evaluation:** High-performance threshold monitoring hooked into real-time WebSocket feeds with native macOS UserNotifications.
  • **Menubar Companion Submenu:** Manage, inspect, and clear active and triggered alerts from the system status bar menu.
  • **Refined Empty States & Polish:** Balanced frosted slot placeholder, zero-layout-shift popover sizing, and keyboard shortcuts.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.5.0
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.5.0

  • Multi-Display Support: Choose where CryptoNotch lives across connected monitors (Studio Display, external 4K/5K screens, or built-in Retina)
  • Smart Clamshell Switching: Automatically routes to your primary external display when your MacBook lid is closed, and snaps back when reopened
  • Seamless U-Shape Notch Geometry: Flat-top U-shape design bleeds directly into the physical top bezel on external monitors without wallpaper gaps
  • Menubar Display Selector: Instantly switch between monitors or Automatic mode from the menu bar with live hot-plug detection

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.4.0
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.4.0

  • Quick Disable Hotkey: Press ⌥⇧D (Option+Shift+D) to instantly collapse and disable the notch
  • Dynamic Menubar Action: Added clean Disable Notch ⇄ Enable Notch toggle without confusing checkmarks
  • Pure Horizontal Curtain Animation: Fluid spring-driven animation that shrinks horizontally into the physical camera housing
  • Click & Hover Pass-Through: Mouse events pass completely through to underlying windows when disabled
  • Standardized Notch Nomenclature: Polished UI copy and renamed Stealth Mode to Show Only on Hover

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.3.2
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.3.2

  • Refined App Icon: Removed notch tether line and perfected the golden sun coin silhouette rising over the island

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.3.1
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.3.1

  • Rock-Solid Transitions: Replaced lateral sliding with a calm, native opacity crossfade and eliminated capsule twitching
  • Single-Command Release Script: Fully automated version bumping, building, Sparkle signing, appcast feed, and Homebrew tap updates

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.3.0
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.3.0

  • Fluid Favorite Cycling: Cycle through pinned favorite coins instantly with two-finger horizontal trackpad swipes over the notch, or system-wide using Option + Shift + Left/Right Arrow (⌥⇧← / ⌥⇧→).
  • Tactile Micro-Spring Transitions: Punchy micro-sliding transitions paired with an authentic Dynamic Island elastic capsule pulse when cycling pairs.
  • Strict Gesture Latching: Filtered trackpad momentum and inertia to ensure one two-finger swipe navigates strictly to one coin.
  • Direct Number Navigation: Jump directly to any of your top 9 pinned coins with ⌥⇧1 through ⌥⇧9.
  • Popover UI Polish: Streamlined the pair selector and customization sheets by removing unnecessary subtitle clutter and badges.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.2.0
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.2.0

  • Multi-Exchange Support: Added live market data ingestion and real-time WebSocket feeds for Coinbase and Kraken alongside Binance.
  • Full Order Book Depth: Implemented Level 2 depth ingestion across all three platforms, calculating top 20 bid depth, ask depth, and order book imbalance percentage.
  • Rolling Price Changes & VWAP: Added 1-hour and 4-hour rolling price changes, plus 24-hour VWAP synthesis for Coinbase.
  • Dynamic Slot Adaptation: Automatically defaults any unsupported slot metrics when switching exchanges to prevent missing or invalid data.
  • Exchange-Aware Customization: Stats grid editor now dynamically filters available metrics to match the selected exchange.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.1.2
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.1.2

  • Permissionless Global Hotkey: Replaced legacy event monitoring with native Carbon hotkey registration, enabling instant system-wide toggling without requiring macOS Accessibility permissions.
  • Updated Default Shortcut: Changed shortcut to Option + Shift + C (⌥⇧C) for effortless one-handed ergonomics and conflict-free operation with window managers.
  • Status Menu Badge: Added visual ⌥⇧C badge to the companion status menu.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.1.1
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.1.1

  • Refined Menu Bar Layout: Reorganized companion status menu to group app management actions ("Check for Updates..." and "Quit") at the bottom below feature controls, matching macOS HIG standards.

item.title: CryptoNotch 1.1.0
item.description:
CryptoNotch 1.1.0

  • Optimized Network Pipeline: Deduplicated WebSocket events and ephemeral REST snapshots.
